issues.where: the distant rock spire on the left
issues.what: it is oversized, pushed too close to the top-left edge, and rendered as a smooth, vertically streaked grey wedge with no craggy rock detail or roosting birds
issues.fix: push the spire further back into atmospheric haze, reduce its scale, and give it rugged rock texture with distant birds along the ridge

issues.where: the cliff face and lower foreground
issues.what: the dense hanging dark kelp along the bottom is missing, and the rock shows stretched vertical black-and-white striping and smeared orange patches instead of stepped ledges, crusty lichen, and organic guano drips
issues.fix: add wet hanging kelp along the lower foreground edge and replace the stretched rock texture with fractured horizontal ledges, crusty ochre lichen, and thick white guano streaks

issues.where: the roosting colony across the cliff and the flying creature on the upper left
issues.what: the roosting creatures read as uniform flat pale-beige shapes lacking folded ribbed wings, dark seaweed nests, and contact shadows, and the upper-left flyer is flatly over-lit pale cream without translucent wing backlighting
issues.fix: darken and weather the creatures with distinct ribbed wing geometry, place dark tangled nests beneath roosting birds, ground them with contact shadows, and restore warm translucent backlighting

issues.where: overall lighting, sky, and depth of field
issues.what: the scene is lit with flat, washed-out mid-grey light lacking the warm storm-break rim light on the cliff edges and wings, with weak shadow depth and no natural focus falloff
issues.fix: add a bright break in the storm clouds casting warm directional rim light, deepen shadow contrast in the rock crevices, and restore foreground and background depth-of-field separation

issues.where: the distant strait behind the wave
issues.what: only a single smooth, pale leaning spike appears in the center instead of the arcing cluster of four to five rugged sea stacks receding into the mist
issues.fix: restore the group of curved, weathered sea stacks on both sides of the strait receding into atmospheric haze

issues.where: the left and right framing cliffs
issues.what: a large pitch-black, glossy, blobby overhang dominates the middle of the left cliff, and the wet hanging dark-olive kelp draping both tidal cliff walls is missing
issues.fix: remove the pitch-black overhang artifact, match the weathered grey-brown rock shading, and drape wet hanging kelp down the lower tidal zone of both cliffs

issues.where: the foreground tidal flat and water
issues.what: the water looks like a smooth grey plastic sheet with uniform procedural ripples and bubble rings, and the smooth dark boulders sit cleanly on the surface without shallow kelp-covered flats or foreground blur
issues.fix: break up the water into shallow, textured tidal flats with scattered kelp-draped rocks, warm sky reflections, and shallow depth-of-field blur on the nearest rocks

issues.where: the mid-right and upper-right native-size crops of set-B-01-b
issues.what: low-poly blocky rock silhouettes, floating flat grey polygon strips jutting from the cliff, thin blue-grey water trickles, and smooth clay-like creature meshes with painted grey back stripes
issues.fix: remove the intersecting flat cards, refine rock edge detail, replace the blue trickles with crusty white guano, and add fine leathery wing and skin detail to the creatures

issues.where: the right cliff-and-water crop and left cliff crop of set-B-03-b
issues.what: a visible hard dark matte seam outlines the right cliff edge where the spray meets the rock, the foreground water shows unnaturally even parallel ripples, and the dark overhang on the left cliff has a sharp cutout edge
issues.fix: blend and light the spray volumetrically against the right cliff without a dark border, replace the uniform ripples with irregular wind-driven chop, and integrate the left cliff geometry cleanly

issues.where: the seabirds skimming above the water and the sky lighting
issues.what: the skimming birds read as flat grey cutouts with no water-skim splashes or backlit wing rims, and the bright cloud break sits on the left rather than casting warm backlight from the upper right
issues.fix: add backlit rim highlights and small water splashes beneath the skimming birds, and move the bright cloud break to the upper right to backlight the spray and foreground reflections
